title: the live restore could not start from the host

findings.claim: backup-nightly --deploy deploy bound the public key and the dump folder by relative path, which the container engine reads as volume names: the nightly failed when typed from the install folder
findings.severity_basis: no backup is written by the documented form of the command
findings.fix: the schedule's entries and the job's public key path are made absolute (backup_schedule.absolute); tests/unit/test_restore_from_the_host_h100.py
findings.from: the integrator's red 7106858719 (the MVP walk's step 8 on the bench host), 2026-11-23

findings.claim: trialbox restore typed on the host ran in a plain one-off container with no hapi URL, no data volume, no database client and no way to run the role script, so it stopped before changing anything
findings.severity_basis: restore is part of the MVP: a box could not be restored from its backup by any documented command
findings.fix: the host form runs the restore in the backup image as the nightly's job runs, with the box's own URLs and role passwords by name, the volumes bound, the role script inside, --last and --restart; tools/trialbox/box_restore.py; tests/unit/test_restore_from_the_host_h100.py
findings.from: the integrator's red 7106858719 (the MVP walk's step 8 on the bench host), 2026-11-23

findings.claim: the backup image carried no database client tools, so a restore or a drill run in it had no pg_restore
findings.severity_basis: the restore's container cannot restore a database without them
findings.fix: deploy/docker/backup.Dockerfile installs the client tools of the server's major from the db base's own source, pinned, held and checked; tests/unit/test_restore_from_the_host_h100.py
findings.from: the integrator's red 7106858719 (the MVP walk's step 8 on the bench host), 2026-11-23

findings.claim: the nightly's job container builds the hapi URL with the database password unquoted (update.ComposeBox._backup_container): a password holding @, / or # would give a URL that names another host or database
findings.severity_basis: install.sh's generated passwords may not hold those characters; a site's own password could, and the nightly's hapi snapshot would then fail
findings.fix: not in this card (update.py is in flight on H-99 and H-95); the host restore quotes it (box_restore.job_db_env)

findings.claim: backup_schedule.config lets the process environment win over deploy/.env for every TB_ setting, TB_BACKUP_PUBKEY and TB_BACKUP_TARGETS among them, and ComposeBox reads TB_BACKUP_PUBKEY, TB_COMPOSE and TB_DOCKER from the process: a person who runs backup-nightly with one exported decides where the backup goes and what it is encrypted to
findings.severity_basis: cron and sudo drop the caller's environment, so the schedule is not affected; a hand run with sudo -E or a kept variable is
findings.fix: not in this card. On the restore's path a caller steers none of them: `trialbox restore` on the host takes the public key, the copy folder, the targets (--last), the engine and compose from deploy/.env (BoxRestore, __main__._restore_defaults, last_good with process_env=False), and the container gets only the names it is given; tested by test_the_host_restore_takes_every_url_from_the_box_and_none_from_the_caller. A caller steers them in backup-nightly, backup-status and backup-install (config) and in the update's backup (ComposeBox: TB_BACKUP_PUBKEY, TB_COMPOSE, TB_DOCKER, TB_MODELS_DIR)
findings.from: reading backup_schedule.py and update.py for card H-100, 2026-11-23

findings.claim: the live restore over a real stack (all services healthy after it, the restored rows equal backup-verify's) and the backup image with the client tools were not run or built in this card's session
findings.severity_basis: the done criterion of the card is proved only by the rehearse jobs (box.sh live-restore) or the bench
findings.fix: the rehearsal's live-restore step runs it in CI; the bench repeats step 8 with the one documented command
